key_idea: Particles react only when they collide with enough energy. That minimum energy is the **activation energy**. Concentration, pressure and surface area raise the frequency of collisions. Temperature raises both the frequency and the energy of collisions.

blocks.text: Collision theory explains why the factors in the previous note change the rate. It has two conditions for a reaction.

items.text: Surface area = 6 × 1 × 1 = 6 cm². Volume = 1 cm³. The ratio is 6 /cm.
